post.summary: Create any audio content with a user provided script
post.description:
Starts a background job to produce an audio file with the provided script segments. The response
    contains a `job_id` that can be used to query with the `/podcast/{job_id}` to query for status.
    Requires a valid `X-API-TOKEN` header.

    Throws:
    - 429 if the user has too many jobs in flight.
    - 400 if any voice_id or music_id provided is invalid

post.summary: Create any audio content with an AI-generated script
post.description:
Starts a background job that creates an AI generated script and produces an audio file.
    The response contains a `job_id` that can be used with the `/podcast/{job_id}` endpoint
    to query for status.
    Requires a valid `X-API-TOKEN` header.

    Throws:
    - 429 if the user has too many jobs in flight.
    - 422 if provided voice_ids are not unique
    - 400 if any voice_ids or music_ids provided are invalid

get.summary: Get audio content result and status
get.description:
Gets the status of podcast generation job, including a link to download it if the job was
    successful. Requires a valid `X-API-TOKEN` header.


    The link returned expires after 24 hours.
    Feel free to call this endpoint again to get a fresh link, no need to regenerate the podcast
    and waste credits.

    Throws
    - 404 if job_id is invalid

post.summary: Generate AI-scripted podcast with 2 hosts using Convo Mode
post.description:
Starts a background job that creates an AI generated script and produces an audio file in convo mode.
    The response contains a `job_id` that can be used with the `/podcast/{job_id}` endpoint
    to query for status.
    Requires a valid `X-API-TOKEN` header.


    **Note that generating via Convo Mode yields more natural results but takes longer.
    Expect at least 1 minute of processing per minute duration of audio before investigating a potential failure.**

    Throws:
    - 429 if the user has too many jobs in flight.
    - 400 if any voice_ids provided are invalid or if the length of voice_ids is not 2.

post.summary: Generate podcast with 2 hosts using Convo Mode, with a user provided script
post.description:
Starts a background job to produce an audio file with the provided script segments in convo mode. The response
    contains a `job_id` that can be used to query with the `/podcast/{job_id}` to query for status.
    Requires a valid `X-API-TOKEN` header.


    **Note that generating via Convo Mode yields more natural results but takes longer.
    Expect at least 1 minute of processing per minute duration of audio before investigating a potential failure.**


    Throws:
    - 429 if the user has too many jobs in flight.
    - 400 if any voice_ids provided are invalid or if the length of voice_ids is not 2.

get.description:
Lists the image models available through the API, with the resolutions, aspect ratios and
credits per image each one supports. Requires a valid `X-API-KEY` header.

post.description:
Uploads a PNG, JPEG or WebP image (up to 20 MB) to use as a reference when generating images
or videos. Returns an `image_id` to pass in `reference_image_ids` (or as a video start/end frame).
Requires a valid `X-API-KEY` header.

Throws:
- 400 if the file is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image, or its dimensions are too large
- 413 if the file is larger than 20 MB

Starts a background job that generates images from a prompt, optionally editing or combining
reference images. The response contains a `job_id` to poll with `GET /image/{job_id}`, and the
credits the job will be charged. Requires a valid `X-API-KEY` header.

Throws:
- 400 if the model, resolution or aspect ratio is not supported, the model does not accept
  reference images, or the prompt references images the request does not carry
- 402 if the workspace does not have enough credits, or the model is not available on its plan
- 404 if a reference image does not exist or is not accessible
- 422 if the request body is invalid

get.summary: Get image job status and results
get.description:
Gets the status of an image generation job, with download links once it has succeeded.
Requires a valid `X-API-KEY` header.

The links expire after 24 hours. Call this endpoint again for fresh links instead of
regenerating the images.

Throws:
- 404 if the job does not exist or was not created with this API key's user

Lists the video models available through the API, with the modes, resolutions (and credits per
second at each), durations and aspect ratios each one supports. Requires a valid `X-API-KEY` header.

post.summary: Upload a reference or source video
post.description:
Uploads an MP4 or MOV video (up to 100 MB and 60 seconds) to use as a reference clip or as the
video to edit. Returns a `video_id` to pass in `reference_video_ids` or as `source_video_id`.
Requires a valid `X-API-KEY` header.

Throws:
- 400 if the file is not an MP4 or MOV video, has no video stream, or is longer than 60 seconds
- 413 if the file is larger than 100 MB

Starts a background job that generates a video. The mode follows from the inputs you send:
nothing extra for text-to-video, `start_frame_image_id` for image-to-video (plus
`end_frame_image_id` for first/last frame), `reference_image_ids` and/or `reference_video_ids`
for references, or `source_video_id` to edit a video. The response contains a `job_id` to poll
with `GET /video/{job_id}`, and the credits the job is expected to cost.
Requires a valid `X-API-KEY` header.

Throws:
- 400 if the model, mode, resolution, duration or aspect ratio is not supported, a clip is too
  short or long, or the prompt references inputs the request does not carry
- 402 if the workspace does not have enough credits, or the model is not available on its plan
- 404 if an image or video does not exist or is not accessible
- 422 if the request body is invalid, e.g. it mixes inputs from different modes

get.summary: Get video job status and result
get.description:
Gets the status of a video generation job, with a download link once it has succeeded.
Requires a valid `X-API-KEY` header.

The link expires after 24 hours. Call this endpoint again for a fresh link instead of
regenerating the video.

Throws:
- 404 if the job does not exist or was not created with this API key's user

voice_ids.description: A list of voice_ids to use for the generated audio. **Must provide exactly 2 voices for this endpoint.** If the script has multiple speakers, we will use the voices from this list in the order they appear in. All ids in this list must be unique. If no IDs are provided, 2 defaults will be used.

delivery_instructions.description: An optional delivery instructions for the generated audio. This will be used to guide the generation of the audio.

music_spec.description: An optional spec for adding background music to the generated script. Note that if the chosenmusic track is longer than the duration of the generated script, it will be cut off.
